// DOMAIN REVIEWER PROBE (DG6 round 6), disposable clone only. SYNTHETIC data. Production-initialized dev stack
// (apps/web/e2e/support/with-stack.sh). TL (dev.lead, not admitted) and TO (dev.office, admitted) read: the Executive
// Overview, a benefits register snapshot and an executive pack snapshot, both generated by the TO, after the TO marks a
// benefit sensitive. Marking a record sensitive is an access decision, never a business approval (G1-G6).
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { apiSession, langOf, shot, signIn, SYN_RETAIL, tr } from "../../apps/web/e2e/support/ui.ts";
import { syntheticUser } from "../../apps/web/e2e/support/p3-journey-setup.ts";
import { psql } from "../support/a13-a22-stack.ts";

const ORG = "01920000-0000-7000-9000-000000000001";
const log = (s: string) => console.log(`DOMAIN-PROBE R6 ${s}`);
test.describe.configure({ timeout: 600_000 });

test("R6: restricted label on the overview and on report sections (TL vs TO)", async ({ page, playwright }, info) => {
  const lang = langOf(info);
  const stamp = Date.now().toString(36);
  const TITLE = `Synthetic DOMR6 SECRET ${lang} ${stamp}`;
  const admin = await apiSession(playwright, "dev.admin");
  const lead = await apiSession(playwright, "dev.lead");
  const office = await apiSession(playwright, "dev.office");
  const tid = (await lead.call<{ id: string }>("POST", "/api/v1/transformations", {
    businessUnitId: SYN_RETAIL, name: `Synthetic domain R6 sensitive ${lang.toUpperCase()} ${stamp}`, mode: "end_to_end" })).id;
  const T = `/api/v1/transformations/${tid}`;
  const bo = await syntheticUser(admin, ORG, tid, `dev.domr6.bo.${lang}.${stamp}`, `Synthetic Benefit Owner R6 ${lang}`, "BO", lang);
  const boApi = await apiSession(playwright, bo.username);
  const today = new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 3600_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const mStart = today.slice(0, 8) + "01";
  const ben = await boApi.call<{ id: string; code: string }>("POST", `${T}/benefits`, {
    title: TITLE, description: "Synthetic sensitive benefit (domain probe).", benefitType: "revenue", valueClass: "revenue_uplift",
    ownerUserId: bo.id, currency: "SAR", financialStatementLine: "Revenue - roaming" });
  await boApi.call("POST", `${T}/benefits/${ben.id}/plan-values`, { valueKind: "planned", periodStart: mStart, periodEnd: today, amount: "300" });
  const plain = await boApi.call<{ id: string; code: string }>("POST", `${T}/benefits`, {
    title: `Synthetic plain benefit ${lang} ${stamp}`, description: "Synthetic", benefitType: "cost", valueClass: "avoided_cost",
    ownerUserId: bo.id, currency: "SAR", financialStatementLine: "Opex - network" }).catch(async (e) => { log(`plain benefit: ${e}`); return null; });
  if (plain) await boApi.call("POST", `${T}/benefits/${plain.id}/plan-values`, { valueKind: "planned", periodStart: mStart, periodEnd: today, amount: "100" });
  await office.call("PUT", `${T}/records/benefit/${ben.id}/sensitivity`, { isSensitive: true, reason: "Synthetic commercially sensitive benefit" }, { ifMatch: 0 });
  const reg = await office.call<{ id: string }>("POST", `${T}/reports/registers/generate`, { parameters: { register: "benefits" } });
  let period = psql(`SELECT id FROM reporting_period WHERE organization_id = '${ORG}' AND period_start <= '${today}' ORDER BY period_start DESC LIMIT 1`)[0];
  if (!period) {
    const mEnd = new Date(Date.UTC(+today.slice(0, 4), +today.slice(5, 7), 0)).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const rp = await office.call<{ id: string }>("POST", `/api/v1/organizations/${ORG}/reporting-periods`, { frequency: "monthly", periodLabel: today.slice(0, 7), periodStart: mStart, periodEnd: mEnd }).catch((e) => { log(`period create: ${e}`); return null; });
    period = rp?.id;
  }
  log(`${lang} reporting period=${period ?? "none"}`);
  let pack: { id: string } | null = null;
  if (period) pack = await office.call<{ id: string }>("POST", `${T}/reports/executive_pack/generate`, { reportingPeriodId: period, parameters: {} }).catch((e) => { log(`pack: ${e}`); return null; });
  const label = tr(lang, "access.includesRestrictedRecords");
  for (const [user, role] of [["dev.lead", "TL"], ["dev.office", "TO"]] as const) {
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await signIn(page, lang, user);
    const pages: [string, string][] = [
      [`/executive-overview?organizationId=${ORG}&transformationId=${tid}`, "overview"],
      [`/transformations/${tid}/reports/${reg.id}`, "register-snapshot"],
    ];
    if (pack) pages.push([`/transformations/${tid}/reports/${pack.id}`, "exec-pack-snapshot"]);
    for (const [path, name] of pages) {
      await page.goto(path);
      await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
      await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
      await expect(page.locator("html")).toHaveAttribute("dir", lang === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr");
      const text = await page.locator("main#main").innerText().catch(() => "");
      const count = text.split(label).length - 1;
      // Where is the label: the heading just above each occurrence.
      const where = await page.locator(`main#main :text("${label}")`).evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => {
        const sec = e.closest("section"); return sec?.querySelector("h2,h3")?.textContent ?? e.parentElement?.tagName ?? "?"; })).catch(() => []);
      log(`${lang} ${role} ${name}: title shown=${text.includes(TITLE)} label count=${count} under=${JSON.stringify(where)} has300=${/\b300\b|٣٠٠/.test(text)} h1=${JSON.stringify(await page.locator("main#main h1").first().innerText().catch(() => "-"))}`);
      if (role === "TL") expect.soft(text.includes(TITLE), `${role} ${name} must not show the title`).toBe(false);
      await shot(page, lang, `dom-r6-${role.toLowerCase()}-${name}`);
    }
  }
});
